pages.text: The Harbor Lights book club meets on the first Thursday of every month at Corner Grind Café on Wharf Road, starting at 7:00 pm. Priya Raman founded it in 2023 and still picks the books; this month's pick is The Glass Orchard, and members are asked to finish it by chapter 18. Dues are $5 a month, collected by Daniel, who keeps a spreadsheet of who has paid. The café owner, Rosa, reserves the back table for them and gives members 10% off drinks. Parking is free on the street after 6 pm. Later in the season, the group announced that meetings would move to the second Thursday because too many members had a clash with a school event. The venue also changed: Corner Grind closed for renovation, so the club now meets at the Wharf Road public library in Meeting Room B, at 6:30 pm instead of 7:00. Priya stepped back as organizer in March and handed book selection to Daniel. Collecting dues then passed to a new member, Aisha, and dues went up to $8 a month to cover the library room fee. The current book is no longer The Glass Orchard. The group dropped it halfway through and switched to Salt and Signal, with members asked to read up to chapter 10 for the next meeting.

pages.text: The Saffron Bridge project kickoff is on 3 December 2026 in Room 4B. We decided to use PostgreSQL instead of MongoDB for the Saffron Bridge backend. Every Saffron Bridge API response must include a request ID. Priya prefers short bullet-point summaries over long reports. The Saffron Bridge budget review is still unresolved because the vendor quote has not arrived. The Saffron Bridge beta release is planned for 15 January 2027. Rohan will own the Saffron Bridge testing plan.
